## 0) Initialization

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(ggh4x)

# Source scripts (make sure model_functions_ingestion.R + analysis_functions_ingestion.R are updated as we did)
file_sources <- list.files(here("scripts"), pattern = "*.R$", full.names = TRUE)
invisible(lapply(file_sources, source))
```

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
th <- theme_surface_default(base_size = 9, square = TRUE)

tr <- list(
  a_a = 80, b_R = 1,
  a_g = 3, hm = 1, b_O = 2/3, K = 2.0, h = 2.0,
  f_m = 0.1, b_m = 0.75,
  a_e = 20, b_e = 2/3,
  a_c = 60, b_c = 0.75,
  a_SDA = 0.2, a_exc = 0.1,
  T_ref = 10,
  Q10_c = 2.00, Q10_m = 2.00, Q10_a = 1.00, Q10_o = 1.50
)

pO2seq <- seq(0, 30, by = 0.1)
```


## 1) Test diagnostics (single mass/temperature): pO2 vs prey index

```{r}
d_test <- compute_state_surface(
  tr, masses = 1e4, Tseq = 10, pO2seq = pO2seq,
  preys = seq(0, 1, by = 0.004),
  prey_units = "prey_index",
  pair_mode = "cross", progress = TRUE
) %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    M_m_norm   = M_m / Cmax,
    M_act_norm = M_act / Cmax,
    D_SDA_norm = D_SDA / Cmax,
    M_exc_norm = M_exc / Cmax,
    A_assim_norm = A_assim / Cmax
  )

# Optional interpolation per plot (choose only when you want it):
#d_test_ip_E <- interp_surface(d_test, x="f_ref", y="pO2", z="E_net_norm", nx=350, ny=350) %>% add_masks()
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Example: no contours
plot_surface_masked(d_test, x="f_ref", y="pO2", z="U_opt",
                    palette="viridis", fill_title="U*",
                    x_limits=c(0,1), y_limits=c(0,30),
                    contours=NULL, theme=th ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
                     limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0) ) +
  labs(title="Cruising speed", x="Prey index", y=expression(p[O[2]]~"(kPa)"))

# # Example: default contours for E_net_norm + use interpolated surface just for this plot
# plot_surface_masked(d_test_ip_E, x="f_ref", y="pO2", z="E_net_norm",
#                     palette="blue", fill_title="E/Cmax",
#                     x_limits=c(0,1), y_limits=c(0,30),
#                     contours="auto", theme=th) +
#   labs(title="Available energy (interpolated)", x="Prey index", y=expression(p[O[2]]~"(kPa)"))

# Example: custom contour overlay (choose what you contour, and how)
plot_surface_masked(d_test, x="f_ref", y="pO2", z="f",
                    palette="green", fill_title="f",
                    limits=c(0,1), x_limits=c(0,1), y_limits=c(0,30),
                    contours=list(
                      contour_spec(z="f", breaks=seq(0,1,0.2), linewidth=0.22, alpha=0.9),
                      contour_spec(z="g", breaks=seq(0,1,0.2), linewidth=0.22, alpha=0.6, colour="black")
                    ),
                    theme=th) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
                     limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0) ) +
  labs(title="Food limitation with f + g contours", x="Prey index", y=expression(p[O[2]]~"(kPa)"))

# Bivariate mix (contours toggleable)
plot_fg_bivariate(d_test, x="f_ref", y="pO2",
                  x_limits=c(0,1), y_limits=c(0,30),
                  contour_fg_mult=FALSE, theme=th) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
                     limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0) ) +
  labs(title="Bivariate limitation mix", x="Prey index", y=expression(p[O[2]]~"(kPa)"))
```


## 2) pO2 vs prey density (four separate 4-panel plots)

```{r}
d_prey <- compute_state_surface(
  tr, masses=c(1e0,1e4), Tseq=c(5,25), pO2seq=pO2seq,
  preys=seq(0,1,length.out=220), prey_units="prey_index",
  pair_mode="cross", progress=TRUE
) %>%
  add_masks() %>%
  mutate(
    mass_lab=factor(mass, levels=c(1e0,1e4), labels=c("m = 1e0 g","m = 1e4 g")),
    T_lab=factor(T, levels=c(5,25), labels=c("T = 5°C","T = 25°C"))
  )
```

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Available energy
plot_surface_masked(d_prey, x="f_ref", y="pO2", z="E_net_norm",
                    palette="blue", fill_title="E/Cmax",
                    x_limits=c(0,1), y_limits=c(0,30),
                    contours="auto", theme=th) +
  facet_grid2(rows=vars(T_lab), cols=vars(mass_lab)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2), labels = scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.1),
                     limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0) ) +
  labs(title="Available energy", x="Prey index", y=expression(p[O[2]]~"(kPa)"))

# Cruising speed
plot_surface_masked(d_prey, x="f_ref", y="pO2", z="U_opt",
                    palette="viridis", fill_title="U (m/s)",
                    x_limits=c(0,30), y_limits=c(0,30),
                    contours="auto",
                    theme=th) +
  facet_grid2(rows=vars(f_lab), cols=vars(mass_lab)) +
  labs(title="Available energy", x="Prey index", y=expression(p[O[2]]~"(kPa)"))

# Bivariate limitation
plot_fg_bivariate(d_prey, x="f_ref", y="pO2",
                  x_limits=c(0,30), y_limits=c(0,30),
                  contour_fg_mult=FALSE, theme=th) +
  facet_grid2(rows=vars(f_lab), cols=vars(mass_lab)) +
  labs(title="Bivariate limitation mix", x="Prey index", y=expression(p[O[2]]~"(kPa)"))
```

## 5) Metabolic allocation (stacked; explicit excretion)

```{r metabolic-allocation}
mass_seq <- 10^seq(-3, 5, length.out = 120)
scen <- tribble(
  ~scenario, ~T, ~pO2, ~f_ref,
  "Baseline", 10, 25, 0.75,
  "Hyperthermic", 20, 25, 0.75,
  "Hypoxic", 10, 10, 0.75,
  "Oligotrophic", 10, 25, 0.50
)

alloc_state <- purrr::pmap_dfr(scen, function(scenario, T, pO2, f_ref) {
  B_vec <- B_from_f(f_ref = rep(f_ref, length(mass_seq)), m = mass_seq, tr = tr,
                    T_ref = rep(10, length(mass_seq)), pO2_ref = rep(25, length(mass_seq)),
                    U_lo = 1e-5, U_mech = 5, enforce_O2_feasible = TRUE)
  purrr::map2_dfr(mass_seq, B_vec, function(m, B) {
    st <- find_U_opt(pO2_env = pO2, T = T, m = m, prey = B, tr = tr, U_lo = 1e-5, U_mech = 5)
    tibble(
      scenario = scenario,
      mass = m,
      Cmax = st$Cmax,
      f = st$f,
      g = st$g,
      U = st$U_opt,
      `Basal metabolism` = st$M_m,
      `Active metabolism` = st$M_act,
      SDA = st$D_SDA,
      Excretion = st$M_exc,
      `Available energy` = st$E_net
    )
  })
})

alloc_long <- alloc_state %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c("Basal metabolism", "Active metabolism", "SDA", "Excretion", "Available energy"),
               names_to = "Process", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(value_norm = value / Cmax,
         Process = factor(Process, levels = c("Basal metabolism", "Active metabolism", "SDA", "Excretion", "Available energy")))

alloc_cols <- c("Basal metabolism"="#440154", "Active metabolism"="#8a5796", "SDA"="#e0bce8", "Excretion"="gray90", "Available energy"="#67A5CA")

ggplot(alloc_long, aes(x = mass, y = value_norm, fill = Process)) +
  geom_area(position = "stack", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0,1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_scientific(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = alloc_cols) +
  facet_wrap(~scenario, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Mass (g)", y = "Allocation / Cmax", title = "Metabolic allocation") +
  th

alloc_state %>%
  select(scenario, mass, f, g) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(f, g), names_to = "limiter", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(limiter = factor(limiter, levels = c("g", "f"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = mass, y = value, colour = limiter)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(g = "purple", f = "green")) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_scientific(), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  facet_wrap(~scenario, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Mass (g)", y = "Limitation", colour = NULL,
       title = "f and g across size (aligned by scenario)") +
  th
```

```{r metabolic-allocation-2, warning=FALSE}

                    T_ref = rep(10, length(mass_seq)), pO2_ref = rep(25, length(mass_seq)),
                    U_lo = 1e-5, U_mech = 5, enforce_O2_feasible = TRUE)
  purrr::map2_dfr(mass_seq, B_vec, function(m, B) {
    st <- find_U_opt(pO2_env = pO2, T = T, m = m, prey = B, tr = tr, U_lo = 1e-5, U_mech = 5)
    tibble(
      scenario = scenario,

      f = st$f,

      `Active metabolism` = st$M_act,
      SDA = st$D_SDA,
      Excretion = st$M_exc,
      `Available energy` = st$E_net
    )
  })
})

alloc_cols <- c("Basal metabolism"="#440154", "Active metabolism"="#8a5796", "SDA"="#e0bce8", "Excretion"="gray90", "Available energy"="#67A5CA")
```

## 6) E_avail over temperature: prey index vs feeding level

```{r energy-over-temperature}
T_seq <- seq(0, 30, by = 0.25)
fixed_prey_index <- 0.75
fixed_feeding_level <- 0.75
show_U <- FALSE

scenario_grid <- crossing(
  mass = c(1e0, 1e4),
  pO2 = c(25, 10),
  mode = c("Fixed prey index", "Fixed feeding level")
) %>%
  mutate(
    mass_lab = factor(mass, levels = c(1e0, 1e4), labels = c("m = 1e0 g", "m = 1e4 g")),
    scenario = factor(paste(mode, "|", pO2, "kPa"),
                      levels = c("Fixed prey index | 25 kPa", "Fixed prey index | 10 kPa",
                                 "Fixed feeding level | 25 kPa", "Fixed feeding level | 10 kPa"))
  )

temp_series <- purrr::pmap_dfr(scenario_grid, function(mass, pO2, mode, mass_lab, scenario) {
  if (mode == "Fixed prey index") {
    d <- compute_state_surface(
      tr, masses = mass, Tseq = T_seq, pO2seq = pO2,
      preys = fixed_prey_index, prey_units = "prey_index",
      pair_mode = "cross", progress = FALSE
    )
  } else {
    d <- compute_state_surface(
      tr, masses = mass, Tseq = T_seq, pO2seq = pO2,
      preys = fixed_feeding_level, prey_units = "feeding_level",
      pair_mode = "cross", progress = FALSE
    )
  }

  d %>% mutate(mode = mode, mass_lab = mass_lab, scenario = scenario)
})

line_cols <- c(
  "Fixed prey index | 25 kPa" = "#1f78b4",
  "Fixed prey index | 10 kPa" = "#a6cee3",
  "Fixed feeding level | 25 kPa" = "#e31a1c",
  "Fixed feeding level | 10 kPa" = "#fb9a99"
)

ggplot(temp_series, aes(x = T, y = E_net_norm, colour = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(values = line_cols) +
  facet_wrap(~mass_lab, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    x = "Temperature (°C)",
    y = "E_avail / Cmax",
    colour = NULL,
    title = "Available energy over temperature",
    subtitle = paste0("Fixed prey index = ", fixed_prey_index, ", fixed feeding level = ", fixed_feeding_level)
  ) +
  th

limiter_cols <- c(f = "green", g = "purple", U_opt = "#ff8c00")
metrics_to_plot <- c("f", "g")
if (isTRUE(show_U)) metrics_to_plot <- c(metrics_to_plot, "U_opt")

temp_series %>%
  select(T, mass_lab, scenario, all_of(metrics_to_plot)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(metrics_to_plot), names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(metric = factor(metric, levels = c("f", "g", "U_opt"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = T, y = value, colour = metric, linetype = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = limiter_cols[names(limiter_cols) %in% metrics_to_plot]) +
  facet_wrap(~mass_lab, nrow = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Temperature (°C)", y = "Value",
    colour = NULL, linetype = NULL,
    title = "f and g over temperature by scenario",
    subtitle = "Set show_U = TRUE to include U"
  ) +
  th
```
